subject: The 2-minute trick I almost didn't share
preview_text: How to do in 2 minutes what used to take me 20 every single morning. This changes everything about feeding time.
body_paragraphs: I used to stand in my kitchen every morning, staring at the dog food bag, trying to remember if I gave him the right amount yesterday. I'd weigh the kibble, check my notes, second-guess the treats from the night before. 20 minutes of mental math before my coffee. Every. Single. Day.

Then I realized I was making it way too hard. The secret isn't more thinking—it's less. The whole point of PupShape is to take the guesswork OFF your plate, so you can just enjoy your dog. The time you spend worrying about ounces and calories is time you could be throwing a ball or getting a sloppy kiss.

The 'Daily Log' feature. That's the hack. Open it once in the morning, tap in your plan for the day (meals, treats, exercise), and you're done. The app remembers everything. No more kitchen-counter calculations. No more 'did I feed him?' panic. It takes 2 minutes to set your dog's entire day.

Open the app right now and tap 'Log' at the bottom. Plan tomorrow's food in 2 minutes flat. Feel that? That's relief. That's time you just got back. P.S. The dogs who use the Daily Log feature are 3x more likely to hit their first weight milestone. It's not magic. It's just the system working.
